definitions.explanation: Water that has been heated to a comfortable warm temperature. A slightly technical or product-related term — most commonly seen on appliances (washlets, washing machines, pools) rather than in casual conversation, where お{湯|ゆ} is the everyday word.

examples.japanese: {温水|おんすい}⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}いだ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: I swam in a heated pool.

examples.japanese: {温水|おんすい}⟦{洗浄|せんじょう}→洗浄：28525_senjou⟧⟦{便座|べんざ}→便座：20149_benza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A warm-water washlet has been installed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗濯|せんたく}{機|き}→洗濯機：04969_sentakuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{温水|おんすい}{洗|あら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: The washing machine has a warm-water setting, which gets stains out well.

notes:
Compound of {温|おん} (warm) + {水|すい} (water). A slightly technical term; not used in everyday conversation about drinks or baths, where ⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧ is normal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温水|おんすい}⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧: heated pool
- {温水|おんすい}⟦{洗浄|せんじょう}→洗浄：28525_senjou⟧⟦{便座|べんざ}→便座：20149_benza⟧: warm-water washlet (toilet seat)
- {温水|おんすい}⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧: hot-water heating system
- {温水|おんすい}{器|き}: water heater

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧: hot water — everyday word for hot/warm water for tea, baths, etc.
- ⟦{熱湯|ねっとう}→熱湯：13460_nettou⟧: boiling water — water heated to or near the boil
- ⟦{冷水|れいすい}→冷水：22480_reisui⟧: cold water — the temperature counterpart
